control_summary: Cue replaced with 'sized and arranged and has a nearby storage cubby'; neutral, restores the plug-ready bench.

No named entity and no relation, so relationship_named_entity is wrong. Cue is share_wording, so the case rewards lexical matching over inference.

Minor nit: the control replacement adds new positives instead of being strictly neutral, but price still decides.
